_comment: Source of truth for the parity table in README.md and STATUS.md. Regenerate with: python parity/parity_table.py

rows.name: proxy surface
rows.notes: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/models, /health, bearer-key check, Flask jsonify byte format, werkzeug 404/415 pages

rows.name: approach selection
rows.notes: slug prefix, optillm_approach in body, <optillm_approach> tags, & pipeline, | parallel, n repeats, untagging of User:/Assistant: output

rows.name: none (passthrough)
rows.notes: openai-python model_dump shape, create() kwarg TypeError, 2 retries on 5xx/429, SSE re-chunking incl. tool calls and usage

rows.name: batching
rows.notes: --batch-mode/--batch-size/--batch-wait-ms; per model:approach queues, sequential processing, wrapped error messages

rows.name: conversation logging
rows.notes: --log-conversations JSONL ported; not compared by the harness (timestamps, uuids)

rows.name: provider selection
rows.notes: OPENAI_API_KEY, CEREBRAS_API_KEY, AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY supported. OPTILLM_API_KEY (upstream: in-process PyTorch engine) is emulated on the configured provider (see decoder rows). Gaps: LiteLLM fallback not ported; Azure AD (DefaultAzureCredential) auth not supported; --launch-gui (Gradio) not supported

rows.name: self_consistency
rows.notes: difflib.SequenceMatcher ported incl. autojunk

rows.name: mcts
rows.notes: seeded: CPython MT19937 random.choice; numpy log/sqrt replaced by f64 (only affects exact UCB ties)

rows.name: pvg
rows.notes: upstream module-global token counter (never reset, grows across requests) replicated

rows.name: rstar
rows.notes: concurrent asyncio rollouts reproduced; harness serialises mock replies so seeded draws line up

rows.name: leap
rows.notes: Python json/iteration error semantics for malformed example JSON

rows.name: mars
rows.notes: port of optillm/mars (not crates/mars). Shared executor = FIFO semaphore; str-vs-int agent-id quirk kept (agent 0 verifies all, improvement never runs); math_verify fails in upstream's server threads (signal-based timeout) so voting uses the regex fallback natively; agg_HHMMSS ids normalised by the harness; CPython 3.12 Neumaier sum() ported

rows.name: cepo
rows.notes: nested thread pools + as_completed reproduced; process-global mutable config; --cepo_bestofn_rating_type / --cepo_rating_model accepted as str (upstream argparse rejects them, use --cepo_config_file); majority vote uses the MCQ path only (math_verify is unreachable with non-empty completions)

rows.name: z3
rows.notes: solver code runs in CPython+z3+sympy subprocess ($OPTILLM_Z3_PYTHON) with upstream exec globals; harness normalises the exec frame path in tracebacks

rows.name: cot_decoding
rows.notes: Remote provider: identical TypeError for decoding=, slug not an approach. OPTILLM_API_KEY mode: same algorithm over logprobs + assistant prefill (k capped at 20 top logprobs; num_beams/length_penalty/no_repeat_ngram_size unavailable)

rows.name: entropy_decoding
rows.notes: Remote: parity. Local mode: logits-only approximation (1 call/token, top-20 logprobs, attention metrics = 0, no clarification-token insertion)

rows.name: thinkdeeper
rows.notes: Remote: parity. Local mode: same control loop, chunked with stop=[end_think_token]; max_thoughts checked between chunks

rows.name: deepconf
rows.notes: Remote: parity. Local mode: warmup/threshold/consensus/weighted vote over top-k logprobs; early termination applied post hoc

rows.name: autothink
rows.notes: Remote: parity. Local mode: NOT available (needs in-process complexity classifier + steering vectors on hidden states)

rows.name: coc
rows.notes: code runs in a Jupyter kernel through upstream's own execute_code (py_helper.py via $OPTILLM_PYTHON with nbconvert + ipykernel); literal_eval via the same helper

rows.name: compact
rows.notes: tiktoken cl100k_base via tiktoken-rs; models.retrieve() context-length probe reproduced

rows.name: deep_research
rows.notes: TTD-DR loop ported (draft, decomposition, gap analysis, targeted search, readurls, denoising, scoring, finalisation with placeholder cleanup, report fixing, references and metadata), including the client wrapper's max_retries=0 attempt with fallback to the original client. Searches use web_search's HTTP backend instead of upstream's shared Chrome session; the harness swaps upstream's searcher onto the same backend to compare

rows.name: deepthink
rows.notes: SELF-DISCOVER 39 modules + 4 JSON-recovery strategies + uncertainty routing (difflib, Neumaier sum)

rows.name: executecode
rows.notes: same helper; upstream's tuple-unpacking bug for code blocks in the request is reproduced

rows.name: json
rows.notes: no-schema and error paths at parity; with a json_schema upstream generates locally (Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B via outlines), optillm-rs asks the provider for strict structured output (xfail fixture)

rows.name: longcepo
rows.notes: upstream v0.4.0 loads longcepo/main.py as a top-level module, so its relative imports raise 'attempted relative import with no known parent package' on every request; that error is reproduced. The LongCePO pipeline itself is not ported, since upstream cannot run it

rows.name: mcp
rows.notes: native MCP client (stdio, legacy SSE, Streamable HTTP; initialize handshake as the mcp 2.3 SDK) against ~/.optillm/mcp_config.json; server.tool functions, per-call fresh connections, result/error JSON verbatim. Not reproduced: upstream's extra pre-spawned stdio process and 2 s startup sleep; the output-schema check covers missing structured content but does not jsonschema-validate it

rows.name: memory
rows.notes: sklearn TfidfVectorizer + cosine ported; OPTILLM_MEMORY_FILE persistence

rows.name: privacy
rows.notes: Presidio + spaCy en_core_web_lg anonymisation through upstream's own code (py_helper.py via $OPTILLM_PYTHON); de-anonymisation native

rows.name: proxy
rows.notes: ~/.optillm/proxy_config.yaml (env interpolation, defaults, validation), round_robin / failover routing, model_map, system-message probe + merge, unhealthy marking, fallback client, wrapped approaches with upstream's handler quirks (rstar / cepo TypeErrors), /v1/models listing. Weighted routing draws from its own RNG rather than the request-seeded one

rows.name: readurls
rows.notes: bs4 get_text rules on an HTML5 parser (html5ever instead of lxml: malformed-HTML recovery can differ); requests URL normalisation (empty query dropped); network errors worded differently

rows.name: router
rows.notes: routing model (ModernBERT-large) runs through upstream's own code in py_helper.py (torch + transformers); routed approaches run natively with upstream's call defaults; fallback path harness-verified (model offline in CI)

rows.name: spl
rows.notes: strategy DB in $OPTILLM_SPL_DATA_DIR (upstream: inside its package dir); TF-IDF with sklearn English stop words; set() order in strategy merges is hash-seed dependent upstream (first-seen order here)

rows.name: web_search
rows.notes: query extraction, formatting, enhanced-query layout and the post-search delay (randint(4, 32) after every loaded results page) verbatim, harness-verified with upstream's searcher swapped onto the same backend. The search itself uses an HTTP backend (DuckDuckGo HTML or SearXNG) instead of upstream's Selenium-driven Chrome on google.com; OPTILLM_SEARCH_DELAY_SCALE scales the sleep
